$Comment: The disenchanter's kit at the table: four independent rolls, one per cloth piece, referenced from the Disenchant action's Bonus.Lootables and rolled once per ritual at its Payout beat. Each is a flat 1.5 percent with no factors and no gate, so every ritual has the same small chance at every piece and a lucky ritual can pay two; the four pieces and the grimoire trophy form the set in ZiggfreedCommon/GearSets/RPG_Disenchanters_Kit.json, which adds Disenchanting Proficiency at two, four and four-plus-grimoire. Each roll names the table's own Cue:Kit_Find moment, which the Disenchant action dresses. A Lootable folds by id and a later layer replaces the whole file, so a pack that wants each piece found to make the next likelier, or luck to weigh in, ships its own Disenchant_Kit.json with the same four grants and its own chances.
